symptom: events + fundamentals workers failed EVERY night for months under a green tick
rootCause: || echo "(non-fatal)" swallowed exit codes in nightly-maintenance.yml
fix: record failures to $RUNNER_TEMP/worker-failures, fail the run at the END so every step still runs
lesson: best-effort must never mean invisible - record, continue, fail at the end

symptom: drift check silently skipped when the DB secret was missing
rootCause: a check that skips quietly is indistinguishable from a check that passes
fix: --require-db flag makes a missing secret a FAILURE
lesson: a check that silently skips is the same lie as a check that always passes

symptom: pre-push hook passed while CI failed on the same push
rootCause: hook read version.ts off DISK, so an unrelated uncommitted bump satisfied it; CI only sees the commit
fix: judge the version in the COMMITS BEING PUSHED (git show HEAD:...)
lesson: a local gate that can disagree with CI is worse than no gate

symptom: CI red ~9 hours of every day; safety-critical bypass tests passing for the wrong reason
rootCause: tests built clocks in the runner's timezone while the router evaluates in Australia/Sydney
fix: npm test pins TZ=UTC; tests pass explicit zones + absolute UTC instants
lesson: tests must not depend on the machine - a local run must be byte-identical to CI

symptom: seven migrations unapplied back to 018; AI ran unpersonalised, votes could not save
rootCause: /data-integrity Stage 1 SAID to diff migrations against live - prose instructions do not execute themselves
fix: the instruction became a script (check-schema-drift.mjs) run nightly
lesson: prose in a playbook does not hold a line - deterministic checks do

symptom: APP_VERSION went BACKWARDS on a green push (0.43.1 prepended under a concurrent session's 0.44.0)
rootCause: two agent sessions share one tree and the version counter had no direction check
fix: a moved version must move UP vs origin/main; blocked its own author the same day (0.53.0 under 0.54.0)
lesson: in a shared tree, every shared counter needs a monotonicity guard

symptom: the scout's 14-day drumbeat window read limit(2000) UNORDERED - clustering would quietly weaken as volume grew
rootCause: a limit() over growing data is a future silent truncation; unordered, Postgres drops arbitrary rows
fix: ordered newest-first, limit raised 3x volume, filling it flags window_saturated + logs ERROR
lesson: any cap must be observable when it is hit - if nothing can notice the limit, the limit is a lie waiting to happen

symptom: workers exited 0 and steps stayed green while company_events, fundamental_snapshots and every scout idea card wrote ZERO rows
rootCause: ON CONFLICT cannot infer a PARTIAL unique index (42P10); per-row catches logged and moved on
fix: predicates dropped (NULLs are distinct anyway); workers now RAISE when fetched>0 but persisted==0
lesson: a job that stores nothing must go red - and never create a partial unique index as an upsert target

symptom: a fresh clone could not build the schema at all; 9 fossils (a seed with a dead ON CONFLICT, 8 indexes on columns other migrations never added)
rootCause: migrations were only ever applied to databases that already had the fossils' assumptions
fix: CI applies EVERY migration + the sql/ reconcile against throwaway Postgres on every push
lesson: the only proof a schema builds from zero is building it from zero, every time

symptom: six live-only bugs shipped behind fully green CI
rootCause: CI proves the build; nothing proved the DEPLOYMENT (env, middleware, edge, secrets)
fix: every push to main waits for the live site to serve the pushed version, then probes health + content + middleware
lesson: a deploy is a separate artifact from a build and needs its own gate

symptom: UnboundLocalError on every keyless scout run after a live-path refactor
rootCause: live and demo forked into two cluster paths; a refactor of one silently broke the other
fix: ONE pipeline - mode only changes inputs and sinks; keyless path pinned by a test
lesson: demo mode doubles every code path you fork - so don't fork

symptom: if every feed failed, the scout would persist SAMPLE stories into live scout_items and file sample cards on the real board
rootCause: the demo-items fallback ran through the same persist path as live fetches
fix: used_demo_fallback gates every live write; fabricated data never touches live tables
lesson: a demo fallback inside a live path is a write-path until proven otherwise
